summary: GLM-5.3-Flash reuses the cached previous answer in multi-turn chats when that answer ends in whitespace
compatibility: The GLM profile now passes --chat-template with the runtime's copy of the official GLM-5.3 template, changed only to render assistant content as generated instead of stripped. CHAT_TEMPLATE=checkpoint restores the checkpoint's template; any other CHAT_TEMPLATE value, or --chat-template, is passed to vLLM.
details: The checkpoint's template renders a previous answer with content.strip(). An answer the model ended with a newline, for example after a code block, no longer matched the generated tokens, so the next request recomputed the whole previous response: ktsaou measured 6,026 instead of 7,848 of 7,853 prompt tokens reused.
Answers without leading or trailing whitespace render exactly as before. When whitespace is present, the history now holds exactly the tokens the model produced.
